page_budget_rule.over_ceiling_action: Split into coherent sub-subtopics first; exceed only with explicit owner exception. Never compress away necessary inferential steps.

principles: Segment complex material into meaningful learner-paced units.
Use signaling/cueing to direct attention to relevant visual and textual structure.
Use multiple representations in Physics when they clarify or enable reasoning.
More diagrams are not automatically better; every visual must perform an instructional function.
research_basis.notes: Exact page ceilings are product heuristics, not psychometric or research-derived thresholds.

EASY.web_research_exception: Required only when source integrity, factual uncertainty, current external information or a missing representation demands verification.
EASY.diagram_rule: Use diagrams where they materially improve understanding; decorative images do not count.

MEDIUM.research_scope: Find established representations, misconception patterns, worked-example structures and visual explanations relevant to the subtopic; adapt, do not copy.
MEDIUM.diagram_rule: Provide dedicated diagrams for major model/representation changes and difficult inferential steps.

HARD.research_scope: Research established representations, misconception evidence, expert solution structures, alternative representations and high-value visual explanations; adapt, do not copy.
HARD.diagram_rule: Use dedicated diagrams/visual sequences for each major conceptual transition; consider one or more sub-subtopic visual narratives when needed.

layer_specific_realization.CORE1A: Declarative: explain completely at solution level, including full worked reasoning, derivations/checks where useful and misconception contrast.
layer_specific_realization.CORE1B: Generative: preserve the same bucket depth but turn the learner into the active constructor using open-ended prompts, attempt space, progressive help, local resolution and repair.
